stage: H4 OFFICIAL run (docs/04-phase4-plan.md, H4 section + Amendments 3, 5, 6). Code: run_official.py. Not yet run: waiting for RAISE PNG reals and SD3.5/FLUX fakes (grip.unina.it).
rigid_params_from: config.json (sigmas, draws, batch, noise, feature variants, d008): imported unchanged from the pilot module, single source of truth

pilot.note: used by --dry-run only (VISION + 6 Synthbuster; no RAISE/SD3.5/FLUX)

arm_notes.orig: 003 crops: centre 512 crop of the raw image, NO resize (D-009); then the 224 centre crop
arm_notes.fov512: short side -> 512 (bicubic, antialiased), centre crop 512 (004/fov_prep.py), then the 224 centre crop
arm_notes.fov224: short side -> 224 (bicubic, antialiased), centre crop 224 (004/fov_prep.py --size 224): the whole image at 224. Settings (iv)/(iv-p) are not defined here: resize(0.5) would leave 112 px < the 224 input

label_arm_note: Amendment 6.4: the label comes from the arm D-013 makes primary; until the owner decides this is `orig` (D-009). The other arms are reported alongside.

generators.note: LOGO-macro (the headline AUROC) is over `main`; each has a LOGO B0 model. FLUX has no train/calib rows: B0 scores it with the model fitted on ALL b0_train rows, RIGID has no training; it is reported per generator and as a macro sensitivity `macro_incl_flux`.

i.desc: VISION native camera JPEG vs clean PNG fakes

ii.desc: RAISE PNG vs clean PNG fakes (no format shortcut on either side)

M.desc: RAISE re-saved jpeg(90) vs clean PNG fakes: only the reals' encoding differs from (ii)

iii-p.desc: pilot continuity: VISION native re-encoded jpeg(90) + fakes jpeg(90)

iv-p.desc: pilot continuity: VISION native + fakes jpeg75_resize05

primary_contrast_note: AUROC(M) - AUROC(ii): same RAISE reals, same fakes, only the reals' encoding differs (Amendment 6.2)
validity_gate: Amendment 6.1 at the best sigma (highest AUROC(ii)): CI lower bound of AUROC(ii) > 0.5 AND RIGID AUROC(ii) > texture-baseline AUROC(ii). Otherwise UNINFORMATIVE.

texture_baseline.score: mean |Laplacian| of the grey 224 input (after the condition), lib/h4.laplacian_texture
texture_baseline.direction: set ONCE per (arm, real pool, Firefly variant) on `clean` images: calib-split reals of that pool vs TRAIN-split fakes of the variant's generators (there are no calib-split fakes); never on test
texture_baseline.note: the pre-registration says 'calib-split reals and fakes'; since calib holds reals only, the fakes come from the train split. FLUX is never used.

residualized_rigid: Amendment 6.5: OLS score ~ a + b log(Laplacian) fitted on the calib-split reals of the setting's pool in the setting's real condition; AUROC of the residual on test (descriptive)
cross_scale_b0: Amendment 6.6: B0 fitted on arm A features (b0_train, clean), standardised with A's b0_train reals, applied to arm B features of the same images; all ordered arm pairs, all conditions available in both arms (descriptive)
manipulation_check: Amendment 6.3: for every contrast, mean Laplacian of the test reals and of the test fakes under the two settings (difference, ratio) next to B0's gap and the texture baseline's gap

operating_point.threshold: calib-split reals of the pool, `clean`, per sigma; applied to the test reals/fakes of each setting

aggregation.bootstrap: lib/h4 FakeSet/RealSet: reals by device (a RAISE image is its own cluster), fakes by image per generator, fakes' resampling shared across real pools; n_boot 2000, seed 0, 95% percentile

standin_raise.note: 20 VISION train-split natives re-saved as PNG. A code-path fixture ONLY: it is not RAISE and every number computed with it is meaningless.
